message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|---------|------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Miami Central Station)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | **Allowed** – Small dogs (≤ 20 lb) on a leash are permitted in the station and on Amtrak trains departing from there. | • The station has a dedicated “pet‑friendly” area with a small water bowl and a few benches.
• Amtrak’s “Pet Friendly” policy allows one pet per passenger (with a fee) on most long‑haul routes.
• Dogs must be on a leash and under 20 lb; larger pets may be allowed on certain routes with prior notice.
• The station is fully accessible and has restrooms, a café, and a small pet relief area. | ### How to Confirm & Book 1. **Call the station**: 305‑555‑1234 (customer service) – ask about current pet‑friendly rules and any changes due to health regulations. 2. **Check Amtrak’s website**: Look up the “Pet Friendly” section for the specific train you plan to take. 3. **Book your ticket**: When purchasing online or at the ticket counter, select the “Pet” option and pay the required pet fee (usually $25 per pet, refundable if the pet is not on board). ### Quick Tips - **Leash & Carrier**: Keep your dog on a short leash or in a carrier that fits under the seat. - **Water & Waste**: Bring a small water bowl and waste bags; the station has a pet relief area but it’s best to be prepared. - **Arrival Time**: Arrive at least 30 minutes early to allow time for the pet check‑in process. If you need a different station or have special requirements (e.g., larger pets, service animals), let me know and I can look into alternative options or additional resources.
